odeComponent.htmlView:
3rd ESO English Project about health and healthy lifestyles

Welcome to our project!
In this project, you will learn about health and healthy habits in English.
You will work individually, in pairs and in small groups.
At the end of the project, you will create a video with frequently asked questions and answers about healthy habits.

Image created by Ana Gutiérrez Domínguez

odeComponent.htmlView:
What is this project about?
In this project, we are going to learn about health and healthy habits.
We will talk about food, exercise, sleep and daily routines.
We will also learn how to give advice in English.

Who is it for?
This project is for 3rd ESO students in the subject of English.

How long will it take?
This project will take about 10–12 sessions.

What will you learn?
In this project, you will learn to:

  • understand texts and videos about healthy habits
  • use vocabulary about health, food and the body
  • speak and write in English about daily routines and healthy lifestyles
  • work in pairs and small groups
  • use digital tools to create a final video.

odeComponent.htmlView:
What is the final product?
The final product of this project is a video in English about healthy habits.

What do you have to do?
In small groups, you will create a video with frequently asked questions (FAQs) and answers about health and healthy habits.

Your video can include questions and answers about:

  • healthy food
  • exercise
  • sleep
  • daily routines
  • unhealthy habits

How will you work?
You will work in small groups.
Each group will:

  • choose some questions
  • write short answers in English
  • prepare the video
  • and present it to the class

What digital tool will you use?
You will use Canva to plan and create your video.

Your video should be clear, simple and useful for other students!!

Image created by Ana Gutiérrez Domínguez

Digital safety and students’ rights

Before starting the project, it is important to remember some basic rules for a safe and responsible use of technology.

In this project, you will use digital tools to search for information, write your work and create a video.
For this reason, you must:

  • protect your personal data
  • use safe and respectful online behaviour
  • respect other people’s work and digital rights
  • use reliable sources of information


Read the following infographic carefully before continuing with the project.

odeComponent.htmlView:
Inclusion and Universal Design for Learning

This project has been designed to be accessible, flexible and inclusive for all students.

Different support measures are included during the project:

  • activation of prior knowledge
  • visual support and clear instructions
  • use of simple and guided digital tools
  • flexible grouping
  • teamwork and peer support
  • different ways of participating in the final product.

The project also follows some basic principles of Universal Design for Learning (UDL):

  • multiple means of representation, through videos, texts, visuals and digital resources
  • multiple means of action and expression, through speaking, writing, planning and creating a video
  • multiple means of engagement, through a meaningful topic, collaborative work and a motivating final product.

These measures aim to help all students participate in the project according to their needs and abilities.
